business.name: Mandi House
business.tagline: Yemeni mandi, charcoal grills, karahi and slow broths. Sandringham, Auckland.

story.headline: Mandi is a Yemeni word for a way of cooking. Meat and rice, slow-smoked together until they belong to each other.
story.body1: Located at 573 Sandringham Road, Sandringham, Auckland, Mandi House is a beloved destination for authentic Middle Eastern and South Asian cuisine. Known for its signature Mandi dishes, a traditional Yemeni-style rice and meat delicacy, the restaurant has carved a name for itself among food lovers in Auckland's bustling Sandringham food district.
story.body2: Mandi House offers a casual yet inviting atmosphere, perfect for both dine-in and takeaway. The menu features a wide variety of dishes, including chicken and lamb mandi, biryanis, kebabs, curries, fried rice, and wraps. Their generous portions, affordable pricing, and bold, aromatic spices make it a favourite for group meals and family feasts. Prices start from around $17.99 for a single serve, with family platters also available.
story.body3: Their standout offering, the whole lamb leg mandi, is especially popular for special occasions and weekend feasts. Vegetarians aren't left out either, with options like paneer tikka, vegetarian wraps, and rice bowls. In addition to the regular menu, Mandi House frequently offers weekend specials such as zafrani chicken biryani and lamb paya, which attract a loyal following. The friendly service and quick turnaround time only add to the appeal.
story.believe: Generous portions. Honest pricing. Bold, aromatic spice.
story.cook: Charcoal, time, and overnight marinades. Nothing rushed, nothing cut short.
story.who: Families, friends and late-night tables who came to share.

ritual.headline: Mandi isn't cooked fast.
ritual.intro: It's a Yemeni way of cooking that takes its time. We honour it the old way, then bring it to a Sandringham night.

steps.title: Marinated overnight
steps.desc: Lamb and chicken rest in a blend of warm spice: cardamom, clove, black lime, until the flavour runs deep.

steps.title: Smoked low and slow
steps.desc: Cooked over charcoal until the meat gives way at a touch and the smoke settles into the rice beneath.

steps.title: Served to share
steps.desc: One platter, set in the middle of the table. Eaten with the hands. The way it's meant to be.

menu.intro: Generous portions, bold aromatic spice, and a fire that never hurries. Dine in or take away. Ask us about the weekend specials.
